Business Readiness Lead - SAP Source to Pay contract with local gov    
  Your New Company  
 Join a large and complex public sector organisation undertaking a major SAP S/4HANA transformation program. This enterprise-wide initiative will modernise core business processes, improve service delivery, streamline operations, and deliver a future-ready digital platform. As part of this significant ERP implementation, an experienced Business Readiness Lead is required to support the Source-to-Pay (S2P) value stream and drive business preparedness for successful adoption. 
   
  Your New Role  
 Reporting to the Change & Business Readiness Program Manager, you will lead business readiness activities across the end-to-end Source-to-Pay value stream, ensuring stakeholders, processes, data, testing, and operational teams are prepared for the transition to SAP S/4HANA. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Assessing current S2P processes and identifying readiness gaps. 
 Developing and executing readiness action plans. 
 Engaging stakeholders across procurement and associated business functions. 
 Supporting change, communication, and training activities to drive user adoption. 
 Aligning business processes with future-state SAP S/4HANA capabilities. 
 Supporting benefits realisation and digital transformation initiatives. 
 Coordinating business participation in testing activities, including UAT. 
 Driving data quality, cleansing, enrichment, and transformation activities. 
 Planning and supporting go-live activities, including participation in command centre/war room support. 
 
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 To be successful, you will demonstrate: 
 
 5+ years' experience in business readiness, project/program delivery, procurement transformation, or ERP implementations. 
 Proven experience delivering outcomes within a Source-to-Pay or procurement environment. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills. 
 Experience supporting large-scale business transformation programs. 
 Knowledge of testing methodologies, including UAT and process validation testing. 
 Experience driving data readiness and quality initiatives. 
 Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills. 
 Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
 High emotional intelligence and the ability to influence diverse stakeholder groups. 
 Experience working within cross-functional and virtual teams. 
 
 Desirable experience includes: 
 
 SAP S/4HANA implementation experience. 
 SAP Activate methodology and Fit-to-Standard workshop experience. 
 Experience within local government or other large public sector environments. 
 Relevant qualifications in Business, Finance, IT, Procurement, or a related discipline. 
 Understanding of change management principles and business adoption strategies. 
 
  What You'll Get in Return  
 
 Initial contract through to June 2027. 
 Opportunity to play a key role in a major SAP S/4HANA implementation. 
 Exposure to complex enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. 
 Collaborative program environment with experienced ERP, change, and business transformation professionals. 
 Brisbane CBD-based contract opportunity with flexible working arrangements. 
 The chance to deliver meaningful organisational change and contribute to a high-profile digital transformation program. 
 
      What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Sales Representative (Industrial Products) (Full-Time) – Ausgreen Solar Solutions, NSW & ACT

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
11 Recruitment is assisting Ausgreen Solar Solutions with the recruitment process. If you are a dedicated sales professional with experience in industrial products and a passion for renewable energy solutions, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your sales career.

Position Summary:

The role of Office Manager is responsible for the full operation of office management activities at our company.
The incumbent in the role is expected to operate at a consistently high standard ensuring core administrative systems and relevant personnel are operating effectively and efficiently to adequately meet the needs of our growing business.

Scope of the role:

The scope of this role is broad, encompassing the full scope of activities required to support the smooth running of our office environment.

Main Duties:

- Coordinate and oversee administrative processes relating to tour bookings, accommodation reservations, customer enquiries and day-to-day office operations to ensure efficient service delivery.

- Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company policies, tourism industry obligations and relevant legislative and regulatory requirements; while coordinating recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration and staff record management activities.

OFFICE MANAGER
Crossbay Pty Ltd T/A Drive Ready Australia
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Salary: $79,423 plus Superannuation 
About Us
Drive Ready Australia is a growing vehicle rental and automotive services company based in Perth. We manage a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and are committed to delivering reliable rental solutions and outstanding customer service. We are seeking an experienced and organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Managing the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the business. 
•	Coordinating communication between customers, workshop staff, suppliers and management. 
•	Managing financial administration, including rental payments, driver payments, bank reconciliations, outstanding accounts, payment plans and daily financial reporting. 
•	Administering end-to-end motor vehicle insurance claims, including preparing documentation, liaising with insurers and monitoring claims until completion. 
•	Coordinating fleet administration for more than 200 vehicles, including maintenance scheduling, repairs, onboarding and offboarding, GPS installations and vehicle availability. 
•	Preparing repair quotations, sourcing vehicle parts, liaising with suppliers and panel beaters, and supporting workshop operations. 
•	Preparing operational, financial, fleet and insurance reports for management. 
•	Supervising office administration, allocating tasks, assisting with staff onboarding and providing administrative support to employees. 
•	Preparing rental agreements, maintaining electronic records and ensuring accurate business documentation. 
•	Building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, insurers and business partners while resolving enquiries professionally. 
•	Identifying opportunities to improve office procedures and administrative efficiency. 
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
•	At least an AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Administration or a related field; or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	Demonstrated experience in office management or business administration. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
•	Experience in financial administration, including reconciliations and reporting. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and business management software. 
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Desirable
•	Experience in the motor vehicle, transport, fleet management or automotive industry. 
•	Experience dealing with insurance claims and vehicle fleet administration. 
•	Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero. 
Benefits
•	Competitive salary package. 
•	Stable full-time employment. 
•	Supportive and friendly working environment. 
•	Opportunities for career growth and professional development. 
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

result.description:
A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

What We Offer
Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.
